column1: # Which gate self-test a diff has to re-run, and which it does not.
# Read by .github/scripts/gate-self-tests.py. Every gate in this repository ships
# a self-test that mutates the gate, or the tree the gate reads, and requires the
# gate to redden -- a gate that is only known to pass is not known to detect.
# Those proofs used to run on every pull request, so a README typo paid for all
# of them and a diff that rewrote a gate paid exactly the same, which is to say
# the rule "a changed gate re-proves itself" was enforced by nobody.
# A row says: when one of these paths changes, run these commands. The workflow
# guards each command with `needs.<routing job>.outputs.<id>`, and
# `gate-self-tests.py audit` -- which runs on every diff, because it costs a
# stdlib-python second -- reddens when a row, the tree and the workflow stop
# agreeing. That audit is the load-bearing half. Each way this could rot is
# SILENT in Actions: a guard that names a job the step does not depend on, or an
# output the routing job never declared, evaluates to the empty string, skips its
# step, and reports the job green.
# FORMAT: three TAB-separated columns. Blank lines and `#` lines are ignored.
#   1  id        [a-z][a-z0-9_]*, unique. It becomes an output of the routing job
#                and is dereferenced as `needs.<job>.outputs.<id>`, where a
#                hyphen would parse as subtraction.
#   2  commands  comma-separated. Each must appear VERBATIM as one line of a
#                `run:` in .github/workflows/ci.yml, in a step -- or a job --
#                guarded by this row's id. Drift in either direction reddens the
#                audit, so the manifest cannot describe a workflow that has
#                moved on.
#   3  paths     comma-separated, repo-relative, each an existing file. A diff
#                touching any of them runs column 2.
# ALWAYS-ON, and deliberately so: this manifest, the router, and the workflow
# itself. A change to any of the three re-runs every gate's self-test, because a
# change to the routing cannot be trusted to route itself.
# THE BOUNDARY. A row belongs here when its command exists to prove a GATE can
# fail. `.github/scripts/test-download-model.sh` and `scripts/test_score_clean_label.sh`
# are tests of a tool rather than proofs of a gate, and `scripts/test_evidence.sh`
# is the evidence suite itself; those keep running on every diff. What is routed
# is the mutation harness that proves the suite detects.
